source: Directive tables of the Bareos 25.1.2 Director as carried by odir (crates/odir/src/commands/show_items.rs) plus Onesimus extensions (crates/odir/src/config_check.rs EXTENSIONS)
description: A User resource gives ACLs (or profiles) to a user who logs in through a PAM console.

directives.name: Name
directives.description: Name of the user, as PAM authenticated it through a PAM console.

examples.console: configure add user name=alice description="Backup operator"

directives.name: Job ACL
directives.description: Which jobs this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, *all* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

examples.console: configure add user name=alice jobacl="backup-web, restore-files"

directives.name: Client ACL
directives.description: Which clients this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, *all* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

examples.console: configure add user name=alice clientacl="web-fd, db-fd"

On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

directives.description: Which pools this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, *all* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

examples.console: configure add user name=alice poolacl="Full, Incremental"

directives.name: Command ACL
directives.description: Which console commands this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, *all* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. A console that may use restore needs the dot commands the restore uses as well (for the GUI: .api, .help, .bvfs_* or .ovfs_*). On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

examples.console: configure add user name=alice commandacl="status, list, llist, restore, .api, .help"

directives.name: File Set ACL
directives.description: Which FileSets this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, *all* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

directives.name: Catalog ACL
directives.description: Which catalogs this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, *all* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. A console that may use no catalog cannot list jobs or volumes. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

directives.name: Where ACL
directives.description: Which restore target paths (the where= of a restore) this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, *all* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. An empty list forbids every where= other than the job's own; *all* allows any path. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

directives.name: Plugin Options ACL
directives.description: Which plugin option strings a job may be started with this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, *all* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

directives.name: Profile
directives.description: Profiles whose ACLs the user gets.
